critical_stage: 40-85 days after sowing (flowering and grain formation)
region: India (ICAR-IIMR guidance; Rahuri rabi ET at max yield about 475 mm)
note: ICAR-IIMR Millets Chalisa 2025: "sorghum crops need between 425 and 610 mm of water". Cross-check: MAUSAM 59(2) 2008 (Samui et al.) rabi sorghum at Rahuri "yield was maximum when ET loss was about 475 mm". Also used for fodder jowar in Jowar + fodder.

Kumar et al. 2019, Indian J. Agric. Res. 53(4): "The total water applied in chickpea was 415 mm out of this 356.5 mm consumed in ET." Single irrigated field study in another state; replace with MPKV Rahuri lysimeter value (MahaPoCRA Phase VII) when available.

Singh et al., Indian J. Agric. Sci. 65(9): "Highest mean consumptive use (377 mm water) was recorded when safflower received 3 irrigations". Irrigated optimum, so an upper-end need for rainfed Vertisols.
